title: The latest signal
overview: Today’s index contains 240 recent records. The strongest signals span Consciousness / philosophy, Quantum physics, Neuroscience. Treat the ranking as a reading priority, not a verdict: preprints and ambitious theoretical claims still require independent scrutiny.

items.title: Organizational closure through regenerative signaling as a possible basis for conscious awareness
items.why_it_matters: Along the lines of neuronal global workspace theories, the paper hypothesizes that active neural signal regeneration in recurrent, re-entrant circuits could constitute an organizational basis for states of conscious awareness. In this view, brains are self-production systems that regenerate their own informational, signal states (“neural autopoiesis”).

items.title: ARGON: A GNN-Empowered Compilation Framework for Scalable Neutral Atom Computing
items.why_it_matters: Neutral atom quantum systems offer a promising pathway to large-scale quantum computing due to high qubit uniformity and flexible connectivity. To exploit this architecture, compilers must coordinate dynamic atom transport alongside highly parallel entangling gates.

items.title: From G tolerance to physiological state monitoring: mechanisms and adaptive protection
items.why_it_matters: G-induced loss of consciousness (G-LOC) remains a challenge in high-performance aviation because it can rapidly impair pilot functional capacity and compromise aircraft control. Traditional approaches have largely treated G-LOC as a physiological tolerance or threshold problem, emphasizing maximum +Gz tolerance, centrifuge-based assessment, and post hoc identification of loss of consciousness.
